title: CONNECT-IP Operational and Registry Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for RFC 9484 CONNECT-IP operational and registry policy behavior.
scope: This verification covers configuration-exchange capsule type guidance, burstiness and batching policy, DATAGRAM-only congestion-control disablement, HTTP/3 preference, QUIC DATAGRAM transmission and size limits, oversized IP packet drop and Packet Too Big feedback, ECN suppression and Not-ECT marking, DSCP differentiation and coalescing, authenticated-use restriction, persistent address-assignment avoidance, BCP 38 source-spoofing prevention, shared external-address ICMP forwarding and scope filtering, HTTP/1.x opportunistic-send prohibition and capsule delay, and MASQUE URI suffix Expert Review, token, distinctness, and approval guidance.
preconditions: RFC 9484 CONNECT-IP forwarding and datagram support is implemented.
expected_result: The focused CONNECT-IP operational tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the final RFC 9484 artifacts, generated triage reflects all RFC 9484 requirements as trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: The final RFC 9484 operational and registry policy surface is trace-owned and verified by focused local gates.
